title: Pack Manifest Info
description: Extracts and validates information from behavior pack and resource pack manifest.json files including names, descriptions, UUIDs, versions, and icons.

104.title: BP Name
104.description: The name field from the behavior pack manifest header. This is displayed in the game's pack selection UI.
104.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the name string from manifest header

105.title: BP Description
105.description: The description field from the behavior pack manifest header. Provides a brief summary of the pack's contents.
105.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the description string from manifest header

106.title: BP Custom ID
106.description: The custom identifier for the behavior pack, if specified. Used for internal referencing.
106.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the custom id string if specified

107.title: BP Min Version
107.description: The minimum Minecraft version required to use this behavior pack. Format: [major, minor, patch].
107.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version array as string

108.title: BP UUID
108.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the behavior pack. Must be unique across all packs.
108.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the UUID string from manifest header

109.title: BP Manifest
109.description: General information extracted from the behavior pack manifest.json file.

111.title: RP Min Version
111.description: The minimum Minecraft version required to use this resource pack. Format: [major, minor, patch].
111.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the min_engine_version array as string

112.title: RP UUID
112.description: The unique identifier (UUID) for the resource pack. Must be unique across all packs.
112.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the UUID string from manifest header

113.title: RP Manifest
113.description: General information extracted from the resource pack manifest.json file.

114.title: RP Name
114.description: The name field from the resource pack manifest header. This is displayed in the game's pack selection UI.
114.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the name string from manifest header

115.title: RP Description
115.description: The description field from the resource pack manifest header. Provides a brief summary of the pack's contents.
115.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the description string from manifest header

116.title: RP Custom ID
116.description: The custom identifier for the resource pack, if specified. Used for internal referencing.
116.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains the custom id string if specified

117.title: RP Format Version
117.description: The format_version field from the resource pack manifest. Determines which manifest features are available.

118.title: Sub Packs
118.description: Information about subpacks defined in the manifest. Subpacks allow tiered content for different device capabilities.

121.title: RP Icon
121.description: The pack_icon.png found in the resource pack root. Used to display the pack in selection screens.

122.title: BP Icon
122.description: The pack_icon.png found in the behavior pack root. Used to display the pack in selection screens.

123.title: Skin Pack Icon
123.description: The pack_icon.png found in the skin pack root. Used to display the pack in selection screens.

245.title: Subpack Tiers
245.description: Analysis of subpack memory_tier configurations. Tiers should be properly ordered for device capability matching.
245.x-runtime-constraint-description: Data contains subpack tier configuration analysis
